result.summary: Found 2 minor layout issues related to content clipping and scroll affordances.

issues.description: The category filter pill on the far right is abruptly clipped at the edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle gradient fade or right-side padding to clearly indicate that the category list is horizontally scrollable.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card is cut off at the bottom boundary of the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/margin to the scrollable container so cards don't cut off awkwardly at the edge.
